text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which means teaching machines to grasp the meaning of words and sentences, not just read them as symbols. This technology powers translation services, allowing people to communicate across different languages almost instantly. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which helps companies determine whether customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots rely on NLP to have natural conversations with users, answering questions and providing support. As NLP improves, our interaction with machines becomes more human-like and efficient.
